 Order

Accused Nos.1 and 2 in Crime No.113/2023 registered by Hassan City Police Station, Hassan, for offences punishable under Sections 504, 323, 341, 506, 406, 420 and 34 of IPC are before this Court under Section 438 of Cr.P.C.
2.
Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
3. On the basis of the complaint dated 10.07.2023 lodged by H.R.Ranganath, F.I.R. in Crime No.113/2023 was registered by Hassan City Police Station, Hassan against the petitioners herein and others.
In the complaint it is averred that complainant is an advocate and he had filed claim petition in MVC No.1816/2015 on behalf of Meghashree, who is the daughter of petitioner No.1.
In the said case an amount of Rs.78 lakhs was awarded as compensation to Meghashree, who is the victim of a road traffic accident.

According to the complainant when Meghashree was admitted to the NC: 2023:KHC:41241 hospital he had paid a sum of Rs.3,00,000/- to the petitioner no.1 for the purpose of meeting the hospital expenses and petitioner No.1 had assured to repay the said amount after compensation amount is awarded to his daughter.

On 10.07.2023 at about 1.03 pm, petitioners herein and others allegedly abused and assaulted the complainant when he demanded repayment of the amount of Rs.3,00,000/-, which was availed from him by petitioner No.1.
It is also averred in the complaint that the petitioners had criminally intimidated the complainant.
It is in this background, he has approached the Police and lodged the complainant, which had resulted in registering F.I.R. in Crime No.113/2023 against the petitioners and others.
Apprehending arrest in the said case petitioners are before this Court.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that Meghashree has lost both her lower limbs in the accident and a sum of Rs.78 lakhs was awarded as compensation to her.

Towards the fees of the complainant, who was the NC: 2023:KHC:41241 advocate in MVC No.1816/2015 on behalf of the claimant, sufficient amount is already paid, but at the time of filing the petition the complainant had taken blank cheques from the petitioner No.1 and he has been threatening to mis- use the same and therefore, the alleged incident had taken place on 10.07.2023.
The petitioners are agriculturists and they have no criminal antecedents.

The alleged offences are triable by the Court of Magistrate and Mr Shomashekar K C vs State By Hassan City Police on 18 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/98087148/

Accordingly, he prays to allow the petition.
5.
Per contra, the learned HCGP has opposed the bail application.
6. From the perusal of the complaint averment it is seen that the dispute between the advocate and his client is regarding payment of fees.
According to the petitioner No.1, sufficient fees is already paid to the complainant, who was the advocate on behalf of the claimant in MVC No.1816/2015.
Complaint is silent about NC: 2023:KHC:41241 the fees paid to the complainant by his client.
According to the complainant, he has advanced a sum of Rs.3,00,000/- for the purpose of meeting hospital expenses and the said amount is not repaid.
If that is so, the same is a civil dispute between the parties.
In the incident in question, the complainant has not suffered any grievous injuries.
The alleged offences against the accused are triable by the Court of Magistrate and maximum punishment for the said offence is imprisonment for a period of seven years.
Petitioners are agriculturists and undisputedly they do not have any criminal antecedents.
Therefore, I am of the opinion that the petitioners have made out a case for grant of anticipatory bail.

Accordingly, the following:
ORDER The petition is allowed.

The respondent - Police or any other Police in the State of Karnataka are directed to release the petitioners in the event of their arrest in Crime No.113/2023 registered by Hassan City Police Station, Hassan, for the NC: 2023:KHC:41241 offences punishable under Sections 504, 323, 341, 506, 406, 420 and 34 of IPC subject to the following conditions:
1. The petitioners shall execute a personal bond for a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh only) with two sureties for the likesum to the satisfaction of the investigating officer.
2. The petitioners shall regularly appear before the Trial Court without fail unless exempted by the Trial Court for valid reasons.
3. The petitioners shall not tamper with the prosecution witness and they shall co-operate with the Police for investigation and appear before them whenever called upon.
4. The petitioners shall not involve in similar offences in future.
